messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: P1 - /v1/embeddings returning intermittent 500s in ap-southeast-1; streaming sessions cut short for some clients. Auto-escalation to #incidents. PD: oncall-sam. sample log: ```2026-03-16T02:12:03Z ERROR embedsvc.go:214 status=500 msg=\"runtime panic: nil pointer\" req_id=zz9kx```

sam: taking this. seeing error spike starting ~02:05 UTC after a lib-transport upgrade went out to ap-southeast canaries. collecting traces and crash stacks. tagging nina for runtime and omar for deploy history.

nina: on it. capturing core dumps and checking signal handlers. if it's a runtime panic introduced by the library upgrade we should be able to revert the package.

omar: i can see the lib-transport v2.4.0 rolled at 01:58 UTC to 10% canary then 100% at 02:03. rolling back to v2.3.8 is an option. what's the initial customer impact summary?

sam: impact: a subset of embedding requests and some streaming clients in ap-southeast-1 may receive 500s or truncated responses. prefer "a subset" in customer-facing text. non-ap regions look fine.

taylor: i'll draft the status page initial message. short, factual, empathetic. comms-bot, can you prep an internal ops email template?

sam: initial status page draft (please edit):
```
Status: Investigating (P1)
Impact: A subset of embedding and streaming requests in ap-southeast-1 may fail with 500 errors or be truncated, potentially causing dropped responses for affected customers.
Scope: ap-southeast-1 only; other regions appear unaffected.
Workaround: Route traffic to a different region if feasible. Temporary retries may succeed for non-streaming calls.
Security: No indication of credential or data compromise.
Next update: in ~15 minutes or when mitigation is in place.
```

omar: suggestion: don't include percentages in customer copy. also call out we are assessing whether the lib upgrade caused panics. i suggest adding an empathic sentence. revised draft:
```
Status: Investigating (P1)
Impact: A subset of embedding and streaming requests in ap-southeast-1 may fail with 500 errors or be truncated, causing interrupted responses for some customers.
Scope: ap-southeast-1 only.
Workaround: If possible, route traffic to another region. Retries may help for non-streaming embedding calls.
Security: No evidence of data exposure or credential compromise.
We understand interruptions are frustrating 97 were prioritizing a fix and will post updates as we have them.
Next update: in ~15 minutes.
```

taylor: small copy edits for tone and link placeholder. also add incident id placeholder. updated draft:
```
Status: Investigating (P1)
Impact: A subset of embedding and streaming requests in ap-southeast-1 may fail with 500 errors or be truncated, which can interrupt responses for affected customers.
Scope: ap-southeast-1 only.
Workaround: Consider routing traffic to another region if your application supports it; retries may succeed for some non-streaming calls.
Security: No evidence of data exposure or credential compromise.
We know this disruption impacts your apps 97 were actively working to restore normal service.
Status page: <link to status.redwood.com will be added on publish>
Next update: in ~15 minutes.
Incident ID: GEN-2026-03-16-3
```

sam: good. omar, can you coordinate a rollback to v2.3.8 canary to validate? i'll keep thread updated. ops-rotations-bot, please publish when ready.

omar: rolling back to v2.3.8 on 5% of nodes as a canary. monitoring now.

ops-rotations-bot: Publishing initial status page update: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/GEN-2026-03-16-3 (initial) :eyes:

10m later

omar: canary rollback looks clean 97 error rate in canary hosts dropped to baseline, stack traces stopped. starting controlled rollback to more hosts.

sam: periodic update for status page draft:
```
Update: We rolled back a recent transport library upgrade to a canary subset of hosts and observed errors stop in the canary. We are performing a controlled rollback across the fleet while monitoring.
Impact: A subset of requests in ap-southeast-1 may still be affected during the rollback.
Next update: in ~15 minutes or when we have further progress.
```

taylor: LGTM. comms-bot has posted an internal email template for account teams; omar please DM me with a short list of top impacted customers.

ops-rotations-bot: Published status page update: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/GEN-2026-03-16-3 (update 1)

30m later

omar: rollback completed across ap-southeast-1, monitoring shows success metrics returned to baseline for 40m. no new panics observed.

sam: preparing resolved notice. please draft customer-facing email and internal summary.

comms-bot: draft customer email (shared to /shared/incidents/email-templates):
```
Subject: Incident resolved 97 Embeddings & streaming errors in ap-southeast-1
Hi <Customer Name>,
We resolved an issue that caused failures and truncated responses for some embedding and streaming requests in ap-southeast-1 earlier today. Our engineers identified a runtime regression introduced by a transport library upgrade and rolled it back. Service is stable and monitoring indicates request success rates have returned to normal. We have seen no evidence of data or credential exposure.
Impact window: Roughly 01:58 UTC 97 03:20 UTC on 2026-03-16.
What we changed: Rolled back lib-transport to the previous version and monitored traffic until stable.
If you continue to see issues, reply and we will investigate your specific requests.
Thanks for your patience,
Redwood Inference Support & SRE
```

taylor: please ensure incident ID GEN-2026-03-16-3 is in subject and footer. i'll finalize and share with account reps.

ops-rotations-bot: Resolved notice published: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/GEN-2026-03-16-3 (resolved) :white_check_mark:

sam: post-incident tasks: timeline doc (sam), root cause analysis & mitigations (nina), deploy gating improvements (omar), customer comms follow-up (taylor). assigning in tracker.

nina: immediate mitigations: add runtime panic hooks, instrument panics to Sentry, add unit test that exercises transport edge-case. longer term: improve canary rollback automation.

omar: scheduling a short retro with deploy and infra teams to tighten pre-release checks.

taylor: account outreach done for top impacted customers. no escalations open as of now.

comms-bot: internal note: tag all tickets and emails with incident ID GEN-2026-03-16-3 for tracking.

sam: closing this incident thread and handing follow-ups to the postmortem board. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
